exposure: Soluble vascular endothelial growth factor receptor 1 (sVEGFR1 or sFlt-1)
cohort: The study included 44 cases diagnosed with preeclampsia and 44 control individuals.
finding: Serum VEGF, sVEGFR1, and VEGF/platelet ratio were significantly higher, and platelet counts lower, in preeclampsia cases compared to controls, with VEGF and VEGF/platelet ratio showing good diagnostic accuracy for differentiating preeclampsia.
cross-section timing: At the time of preeclampsia diagnosis.
